## How was it tested?

## Checklist

- [ ] The pull request targets `test` (it goes to `master` later)
- [ ] The commits follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/)
- [ ] New code is covered by tests (80 % at least)
- [ ] The documentation is updated (`Watcher/README.md`, docstrings, `.env.example` for a new variable)
- [ ] A migration, if any, is included and can be applied to an existing database
- [ ] No secret in the code, the tests or the logs
